Role Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Accountant to manage day-to-day accounting operations and ensure compliance with statutory and internal financial requirements. This is an exciting opportunity to grow professionally while contributing to a mission-driven organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Outline the day-to-day and ad-hoc tasks for this role.
  • Primarily working within the corporate NetSuite system, manage day-to-day accounting transactions and maintain accurate financial records.  Some additional work will be carried out in the corporate Google suite environment utilising functional shared Googlesheets etc.
  • Process vendor and employee payments, ensuring timely and accurate disbursements.
  • Calculate, deduct, deposit, and file TDS and other applicable taxes in compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepare and file VAT returns and ensure timely tax compliance.
  • Process monthly payroll and maintain payroll-related records.
  • Maintain the fixed asset register, including capitalization, depreciation, transfers, and disposals.
  • Perform bank, vendor, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities and ensure timely closing.
  • Assist in preparing audit documentation.
  • Coordinate with auditors and regulatory authorities during audits and compliance reviews.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and applicable tax laws.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and internal controls.
  • Provide support on ad hoc finance and accounting projects as required.
","requirements":"
